hero.title: Nokia Snake
hero.subtitle: The first page I shipped.
hero.tagline: A browser remake of the old Nokia snake, built in February 2023 from a grid of divs, a timer, and the arrow keys. No canvas, no framework.
hero.impact: The board below uses the same rules as that repo. The layout is fixed so the grid and the score are visible on this site.

embed.label: Play
embed.title: Start, then steer.
embed.body: Click Start / Restart. Arrow keys change direction. On a phone, use the pad under the board. Eat the red apple to grow. The loop gets faster after each apple. A wall or your own tail ends the run.

problems.d: The snake has to travel a board made of plain divs. Each step is a class moving from one cell to the next.
Arrow keys have to turn the head. On a phone there is no keyboard, so the page also needs a direction pad.
Eating should add a segment and shorten the timer, or the game stays the same length and the same speed.
The loop has to stop when the head hits a wall or runs into its own body.

layers.title: 100 divs
layers.desc: A 10 by 10 flex grid. The snake is the cells with the snake class. The apple is one other cell.

layers.title: Head-first array
layers.desc: It starts as [2, 1, 0]. Each tick drops the tail and pushes a new head one step in the current direction.

layers.title: setInterval
layers.desc: The first delay is 1000ms. Each apple restarts the timer at 0.9× the previous delay, down to 80ms.

layers.title: Arrows and the pad
layers.desc: Right is +1, left is −1, down is +10, up is −10. A 180° turn is ignored so the snake does not eat itself instantly.

highlights: Head-first array, tail drops each tick
Apple grows the snake and speeds the loop
Wall and self collision end the run
